title: Health Step Sample Event V1
description: A source-provided cumulative step count observed over a bounded interval. Health Connect reports one record per origin application; the count is the total steps during [start_at, end_at], never a rate.

end_at.description: Exclusive UTC end of the counted interval.

record_id.description: Stable record identifier supplied by Health Connect for the originating record; retained so source record counts reconcile against server acknowledgements.

privacy_level.description: Health observations default to sensitive; credentials need an adequate privacy ceiling to upload or read them.

data_origin.description: Package name of the application that wrote the record into Health Connect. Observations from different origins stay distinct; a similar value from another origin never deletes this one.

SourceKind.title: Source Kind
SourceKind.description: Health Connect records read by the Android collector. The origin application inside each payload is the data origin; the collector itself is only the transport.
